speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Some fairy's been at my son's back, as one was at my reckoning in Lent. I'd know that fairy's hand anywhere.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Lie as you are. I am not staying to be thanked, and I am not staying to be argued into a name. A man who can joke his own fairy down the stair is a man in credit with himself. By my troth, I am pleased with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am glad you are pleased.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Good. The shop is sorting apples without you, which it can do. I'll send no one up who wants a speech. Down I go.
